datasets.name: ds_freshness
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE signal_code = 'climate' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT (SELECT day FROM asof) AS climate_date, (SELECT max(price_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.price_indicator_daily WHERE trading_symbol_code = '^GSPC') AS sp500_price_date, (SELECT max(observation_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_federal_funds_target_upper') AS fed_rate_date, (SELECT max(observation_date) FROM silver_domain_investments.market_rate_daily WHERE rate_code = 'us_cpi_all_items_not_seasonally_adjusted') AS cpi_date

datasets.name: ds_lights
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE signal_code = 'climate' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT s.lens_name, s.lens_code, s.yes_count, s.band_code AS light_code, s.action_name, s.reason_text FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.signal_code = 'climate' ORDER BY s.lens_code

datasets.name: ds_answers
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(signal_date) AS day FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE signal_code = 'climate' AND signal_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT s.lens_name, s.lens_code, s.signal_name, s.signal_code, CASE WHEN s.is_yes THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS answer_text, s.band_code, s.measured_value, s.threshold_value, s.reason_text FROM monitor_daily_signal s JOIN asof a ON s.signal_date = a.day WHERE s.signal_code <> 'climate' ORDER BY s.lens_code, s.signal_code

datasets.name: ds_light_history
queryLines: SELECT signal_date, lens_name, lens_code, yes_count, band_code AS light_code FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE signal_code = 'climate' ORDER BY signal_date, lens_name

datasets.name: ds_pe_history
queryLines: SELECT i.valuation_date, i.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS pe_ten_year_adjusted, i.price_earnings_trailing_twelve_months_ratio AS pe_trailing FROM valuation_daily_index i ORDER BY i.valuation_date

datasets.name: ds_fed_history
queryLines: SELECT signal_date, measured_value AS fed_target_rate, band_code AS fed_band_code FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE signal_code = 'fed_in_the_way' AND lens_code = 'long_run' AND signal_date >= DATE '2022-01-01' ORDER BY signal_date

datasets.name: ds_trend_history
queryLines: SELECT signal_date, measured_value AS sp500_close, threshold_value AS sp500_average_200 FROM monitor_daily_signal WHERE signal_code = 'market_going_up' AND lens_code = 'long_run' AND signal_date >= date_sub(current_date(), 1100) ORDER BY signal_date

datasets.name: ds_index_day
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT i.valuation_date, i.market_value_amount / 1e12 AS market_value_trillion, i.earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_amount / 1e9 AS earnings_adjusted_billion, i.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS pe_ten_year_adjusted, i.price_earnings_trailing_twelve_months_ratio AS pe_trailing, i.members_used_count, i.member_count, i.members_without_shares_count, i.members_under_ten_years_count FROM valuation_daily_index i JOIN asof a ON i.valuation_date = a.day

datasets.name: ds_top_up
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT c.company_name, c.gics_sector_name AS sector_name, m.market_value_share_ratio, m.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS member_pe, CASE WHEN m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount > 0 THEN m.market_value_amount / m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount END AS member_pe_trailing, m.price_earnings_without_member_ratio AS pe_without_member, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS pe_effect FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE m.is_used AND m.price_earnings_effect_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.price_earnings_effect_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_top_down
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT c.company_name, c.gics_sector_name AS sector_name, m.market_value_share_ratio, m.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS member_pe, CASE WHEN m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount > 0 THEN m.market_value_amount / m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount END AS member_pe_trailing, m.price_earnings_without_member_ratio AS pe_without_member, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS pe_effect FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE m.is_used AND m.price_earnings_effect_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.price_earnings_effect_ratio ASC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_excluded
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT c.company_name, c.gics_sector_name AS sector_name, m.exclusion_reason_code, m.price_date FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE NOT m.is_used ORDER BY m.exclusion_reason_code, c.company_name

datasets.name: ds_members
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT c.company_name, c.gics_sector_name AS sector_name, m.market_value_share_ratio, m.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS member_pe, CASE WHEN m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount > 0 THEN m.market_value_amount / m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount END AS member_pe_trailing, m.price_earnings_without_member_ratio AS pe_without_member, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS pe_effect, m.is_used, m.exclusion_reason_code, m.price_close, m.share_count, m.market_value_amount / 1e9 AS market_value_billion FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id ORDER BY m.market_value_amount DESC NULLS LAST

datasets.name: ds_checks
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), sums AS (SELECT count_if(m.is_used) AS used_count, sum(CASE WHEN m.is_used THEN m.market_value_amount END) AS value, sum(CASE WHEN m.is_used THEN m.earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_amount END) AS earnings FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day) SELECT i.members_used_count AS index_used_count, s.used_count AS member_used_count, round(i.market_value_amount - s.value, 2) AS market_value_difference_amount, round(i.earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_amount - s.earnings, 2) AS earnings_difference_amount, i.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS pe_index, round(s.value / s.earnings, 4) AS pe_from_members FROM valuation_daily_index i JOIN asof a ON i.valuation_date = a.day CROSS JOIN sums s

datasets.name: ds_sectors
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), used AS (SELECT c.gics_sector_name AS sector_name, m.market_value_amount AS value, m.earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_amount AS earnings, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS effect FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE m.is_used), total AS (SELECT sum(value) AS value, sum(earnings) AS earnings FROM used) SELECT u.sector_name, count(*) AS member_count, sum(u.value) / 1e12 AS market_value_trillion, sum(u.value) / total.value AS market_value_share_ratio, CASE WHEN sum(u.earnings) > 0 THEN sum(u.value) / sum(u.earnings) END AS sector_pe, CASE WHEN total.earnings - sum(u.earnings) > 0 THEN (total.value - sum(u.value)) / (total.earnings - sum(u.earnings)) END AS pe_without_sector, total.value / total.earnings AS pe_index FROM used u CROSS JOIN total GROUP BY u.sector_name, total.value, total.earnings ORDER BY sum(u.value) DESC

datasets.name: ds_sector_up
datasets.displayName: Sector members pushing the P/E up
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT c.company_name, c.gics_sector_name AS sector_name, m.market_value_share_ratio, m.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS member_pe, CASE WHEN m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount > 0 THEN m.market_value_amount / m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount END AS member_pe_trailing, m.price_earnings_without_member_ratio AS pe_without_member, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS pe_effect, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS pe_effect_sort FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE m.is_used AND c.gics_sector_name = :sector_name ORDER BY m.price_earnings_effect_ratio DESC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_sector_down
datasets.displayName: Sector members pushing the P/E down
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')) SELECT c.company_name, c.gics_sector_name AS sector_name, m.market_value_share_ratio, m.price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio AS member_pe, CASE WHEN m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount > 0 THEN m.market_value_amount / m.earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount END AS member_pe_trailing, m.price_earnings_without_member_ratio AS pe_without_member, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS pe_effect, m.price_earnings_effect_ratio AS pe_effect_sort FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE m.is_used AND c.gics_sector_name = :sector_name AND m.price_earnings_effect_ratio IS NOT NULL ORDER BY m.price_earnings_effect_ratio ASC LIMIT 10

datasets.name: ds_sector_names
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT gics_sector_name AS sector_name FROM silver_domain_investments.company WHERE gics_sector_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_company_names
queryLines: SELECT DISTINCT c.company_name FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id ORDER BY 1

datasets.name: ds_company_check
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), m AS (SELECT m.*, c.company_name FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE c.company_name = :company_name), steps AS ( SELECT 1 AS step_number, 'Closing price' AS step_name, format_number(price_close, 2) || ' US$ on ' || CAST(price_date AS STRING) AS value_text, 'Latest close on or before the day' AS how_text FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Shares outstanding', format_number(share_count, 0) || ' (' || coalesce(share_count_source_code, 'none') || ')', 'From the latest filing' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Market value', format_number(market_value_amount / 1e9, 2) || ' US$ billion', 'Step 1 x step 2' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Earnings, trailing 12 months', format_number(earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount / 1e6, 1) || ' US$ million', 'Net income of the latest 12 months' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'P/E on trailing earnings (what finance sites show)', format_number(market_value_amount / nullif(earnings_trailing_twelve_months_amount, 0), 2), 'Step 3 / step 4' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 6, 'Earnings, average of the last ' || coalesce(CAST(earnings_year_count AS STRING), '0') || ' years', format_number(earnings_ten_year_average_amount / 1e6, 1) || ' US$ million', 'Average yearly net income, up to 10 years' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 7, 'Inflation factor', format_number(consumer_price_index_value / nullif(filing_consumer_price_index_value, 0), 4), 'Price index today / price index at the filing' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 8, 'Average earnings in today''s money', format_number(earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_amount / 1e6, 1) || ' US$ million', 'Step 6 x step 7' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 9, 'P/E on 10-year inflation-adjusted earnings (the climate uses this)', format_number(price_earnings_ten_year_average_inflation_adjusted_ratio, 2), 'Step 3 / step 8' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 10, 'Index P/E without this member', format_number(price_earnings_without_member_ratio, 2), 'Same calculation over the other members' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 11, 'Effect on the index P/E', format_number(price_earnings_effect_ratio, 4), 'Index P/E minus step 10' FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 12, 'Used in the index', CASE WHEN is_used THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No: ' || exclusion_reason_code END, 'A member is left out when an input is missing' FROM m) SELECT step_number, step_name, value_text, how_text FROM steps ORDER BY step_number

datasets.name: ds_range_options
queryLines: SELECT * FROM VALUES ('5D', 1), ('1M', 2), ('6M', 3), ('YTD', 4), ('1Y', 5) AS t(range_code, range_order) ORDER BY range_order

datasets.name: ds_company_price
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), listing AS (SELECT m.listing_id FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE c.company_name = :company_name), prices AS (SELECT p.price_date, p.price_close, p.price_high, p.price_low, avg(p.price_close) OVER w AS band_middle, stddev_pop(p.price_close) OVER w AS band_deviation, count(*) OVER w AS window_count, max(p.price_date) OVER () AS last_date FROM silver_domain_investments.price_daily p JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = p.listing_id WHERE p.price_date <= (SELECT day FROM asof) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY p.price_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) SELECT price_date, price_close, band_middle, band_middle + 2 * band_deviation AS band_upper, band_middle - 2 * band_deviation AS band_lower FROM prices WHERE window_count = 20 AND price_date >= CASE :range_code WHEN '5D' THEN date_sub(last_date, 7) WHEN '1M' THEN add_months(last_date, -1) WHEN '6M' THEN add_months(last_date, -6) WHEN 'YTD' THEN trunc(last_date, 'YEAR') ELSE add_months(last_date, -12) END ORDER BY price_date

datasets.name: ds_company_figures
queryLines: WITH asof AS (SELECT max(valuation_date) AS day FROM valuation_daily_index WHERE valuation_date <= coalesce(:as_of_date, DATE '9999-12-31')), listing AS (SELECT m.listing_id FROM valuation_daily_index_member m JOIN asof a ON m.valuation_date = a.day JOIN silver_domain_investments.company c ON c.company_id = m.company_id WHERE c.company_name = :company_name), prices AS (SELECT p.price_date, p.price_close, p.price_high, p.price_low, avg(p.price_close) OVER w AS band_middle, stddev_pop(p.price_close) OVER w AS band_deviation, count(*) OVER w AS window_count, max(p.price_date) OVER () AS last_date FROM silver_domain_investments.price_daily p JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = p.listing_id WHERE p.price_date <= (SELECT day FROM asof) WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY p.price_date ROWS BETWEEN 19 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)) , ranked AS (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY price_date DESC) AS recency FROM prices) SELECT max(CASE WHEN recency = 1 THEN price_close END) AS last_close, max(CASE WHEN recency = 1 THEN price_close END) / max(CASE WHEN recency = 2 THEN price_close END) - 1 AS day_change_ratio, max(CASE WHEN price_date > add_months(last_date, -12) THEN price_high END) AS high_52_weeks, min(CASE WHEN price_date > add_months(last_date, -12) THEN price_low END) AS low_52_weeks, max(last_date) AS price_date FROM ranked

lines:
# Market Climate

Two climates read the same three questions. Yes is the unfavourable answer.

- Is the market too expensive?
- Is the Fed in the way?
- Is the market going up?

- Red (2 or 3 yes): sell
- Yellow (1 yes): buy and hold
- Green (0 yes): strong buy

Change the date at the top. The other pages show the numbers behind the valuation answer.

frame.description: Price over earnings of the current members. Valuation answer: too expensive above 22 (long run) or 30 (modern).

lines:
# Climate Deep Dive

Checks the valuation answer. The P/E is the sum of the members' market values over the sum of their 10-year inflation-adjusted earnings. Effect on index P/E = index P/E minus the P/E without that member: positive pushes the ratio up, negative down. Effects are one at a time and do not add up.

frame.title: Checks: member rows against the index row (differences should be 0)

lines: ## Members left out of the day

# Company Deep Dive

Pick a company: its price first, then the steps that turn its filing and price into the P/E the climate uses.

- Step 5 is the trailing P/E finance sites show
- Step 9 is the one the climate uses; they differ when earnings were low in earlier years
- Bollinger bands: 20-day average of the close, plus and minus 2 standard deviations

frame.title: From the numbers to the P/E

lines:
# Sector Deep Dive

Sector P/E = the sector's market value over its 10-year inflation-adjusted earnings. Index P/E without the sector shows how much the sector lifts or lowers the index ratio. Sectors are today's sectors (GICS), applied to every day.
